description: This file contains migration logic for setting up content types and parts related to forms in OrchardCore, including definitions for form elements, labels, inputs, validation, and widget stereotypes.

classes.name: Migrations
classes.description: Contains methods to create and update content type schemas for form-related content parts and types.

methods.name: CreateAsync
methods.description: Initial migration to define form, label, input, and validation parts and types.

methods.name: UpdateFrom1Async
methods.description: Migration step to modify 'Form' and 'Label' types to set RenderTitle to false.

methods.name: UpdateFrom2Async
methods.description: Migration step to set positions for 'Form' parts.

methods.name: UpdateFrom3Async
methods.description: Migration step to re-attach parts and update 'Select', 'Input', and 'TextArea' types.

methods.name: UpdateFrom4Async
methods.description: Migration step to add visibility parts to form elements.
